body.objective: If the complete 132-defect repair theorem or its fresh apparatus pushout is negative, classify the smallest action-derived enlargement capable of changing the certified obstruction rather than repeating coefficient fitting inside the exhausted family.
body.stop_condition: Import both terminal post-repair dispositions. If a valid apparatus unary exists, emit a typed NOT_ACTIVATED result and defer to physical reduction. Otherwise extract the exact residual obstruction class, its degree, tensor type, K_Berger weight, real/pairing dual and support orbit. Generate the complete minimal catalogue of new action-derived field/antifield pairs or invariant Hessian vertices that can hit that class while preserving the certified clock, rod and Maxwell controls. For each candidate compute the extended unary principal block, constraint count, nilpotency and cyclicity equations exactly; prove a minimal construction or a complete no-go for the declared one-pair/one-vertex extension class. Export the canonical ansatz dimension, equation rank, first surviving obstruction, health/causality preflight, independent verifier and a single recommended next action rather than an open-ended model scan.
body.current_gate: minimal genuinely new action architecture after a complete replacement-112 repair no-go
body.forbid: no higher-degree coefficient scan in the same exhausted correction family; no deletion of defect rows; no auxiliary field without its BV dual, action Hessian and principal-symbol audit; no q2/q3, memory or redshift construction before a nilpotent cyclic unary exists; no claim beyond the complete declared one-pair/one-vertex extension class
activates: one selected action-derived unary extension, only if the exact minimal catalogue contains a viable candidate
body.resource_hint: NO-GO-BRANCH ARCHITECTURE CLASSIFICATION. Use the exact obstruction representation to generate the smallest new action family. Conflux may enumerate invariant candidates, but completeness, BV typing and the exact constraint/principal-symbol audit are mandatory.
